query: A critical shipment is delayed and requires immediate operational escalation.
A shipment has a medium delivery delay. Operations should request a carrier update and continue monitoring.
A shipment has a customs exception and customs clearance is pending. Operations need to verify documentation.
A shipment is delayed and the recorded reason is a carrier delay. Historical carrier performance should be considered only as operational context.
A shipment is delayed during a relevant weather disruption. Weather should be treated as contextual evidence.
A shipment is delayed because of port congestion. Operations should consider congestion together with the shipment status and delay reason.
A high-priority shipment has a delivery exception and requires increased monitoring and possible escalation.
